klass_rule: re-runs judge()'s exec on the SAVED completion with the same 6s SIGALRM, capturing the exception type instead of swallowing it; verdict_agrees_with_saved_ok must be true for every row

classes.runtime_error: any other exception (IndexError/TypeError/...) or NameError not naming the entry point
classes.signature_or_name: NameError naming the entry point: the function was never defined

note: stop_reason is ORTHOGONAL to klass: max_new means the 280-token cap was hit, and those rows land in syntax_error or logic_wrong. raw (pre-truncate text) is not saved for the rstrip arm, so the cap is only detectable via stop_reason.
